text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I simply couldn't resist coming here...
Even though I had training scheduled for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! That movie everyone's talking about,
"Attack! Space Baseball Zombies"—
the trailer alone was just too unfair...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is a "Baseball Zombie Planet"?!
Why are they playing baseball in a spaceship...?!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With that constantly on my mind,
how on earth am I supposed to focus on training—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
One student ticket, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-It was utterly incredible...
It truly lives up to being called a grand spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "To think that without that final home run, Earth would have fallen into the hands of space baseball zombies..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Every time I look up at the sky from now on, I'll probably be reminded of that ball disappearing toward Mars...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, going out on a weekday is nice and quiet.
I feel like I could really get used to this...
